summary.text: DIPS AS is a private limited company registered in Bodø, founded 1997-12-01. Its website describes the business as follows: "DIPS utvikler helseteknologi og skaper løsninger for helsepersonell i norske sykehus og kommuner." Its main industry code is 62.200 (konsulentvirksomhet tilknyttet informasjonsteknologi og forvaltning og drift av it-systemer). The register shows 351 employees and 6 registered workplaces. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 790 400 865 NOK and the annual result was 163 960 244 NOK; operating income was up from 688 774 931 NOK in 2024. Its verified website is dips.com, which links to its Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube profiles. It holds a Legal Entity Identifier (6367001EBAEQ4T2WM033). Recent changes in the register: employees set to 351 on 2026-10-13; latest filed accounts year set to 2025 on 2026-07-11.
